name: Pop All The Balloons! 🎈
description:
Throw darts and POP EVERYTHING! 🎈

🎯 Pop balloons for coins and upgrade your darts
🍭 Unlock Candy Hills, Sky Islands and Space
🎈 Team up on the MEGA BALLOON every 5 minutes
🌈 Find all 28 balloons, 4 are SECRET
🔁 Rebirth for permanent boosts

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for new zones!
